rule: Every pair in this cohort is labelled, whatever it yields. Pair membership is never revised in response to observed label counts, so pair selection is independent of teacher outcomes.
sizing_note: Deliberately oversized. Measured yield was 16-78 labels per pair (mean 44.75), so a cohort sized to the central estimate would often land under target and create pressure to extend it. 290 pairs project to ~12,978 labels against a 10,000 target.
